canonicalRequirementQuoteAnchors.quote: **Research every requirement and every part of the system heavily**: how others have built it best, evaluate the options, choose the one **least likely to break**. Write down the decision and the evidence.

**No makeshift or weird hacks.** Each task uses the best, highest-quality proven tool (e.g. a real cron/scheduler, Supabase for a database, Vercel for deploys, or another free best-in-class tool) instead of home-made workarounds.
**Research every form of data that can be gathered about his life, and every connector**, then connect them to manage his life better.

Research agents run as Codex **gpt-6.1-sol, medium reasoning, Fast**, following the mattpocock research skill. Final architecture is planned with **deep modules** (codebase-design principles) **around Hermes**.
**Very malleable system.** Every behavior is changeable through clear files and config, and the system can change itself safely.

**After-every-turn self-check:** after each finished turn (a reply or a completed job), a mechanism reviews what Toy did against what Johan said and asks: Did I fully finish the request? Did I do as much as humanly possible with every resource, access and plugin I have? Did anything go wrong in the system? If so, can I change it, test it right then, and improve the system?
**Self-continuing:** if the work isn't finished, Toy keeps going without being asked (it does not stop at "here's what you could do").

**Self-recognizing mistakes:** Toy detects its own errors and failures, beyond Hermes's built-in skill learning, and turns them into tested fixes to skills, config or code, with rollback. Research how other harnesses do this; plan it with deep modules (Astra + Opus).
Assume Johan forgets everything within minutes; Toy carries all remembering
Auto-capture every commitment, wait or delay. Example: "waiting 3 days on a reply" → put it on the calendar, set a follow-up timer, follow up without being told
Never forget what he said 10 messages ago
Silence never means done. Keep nudging until done or explicitly dropped
Challenge-then-switch when priorities conflict; keep displaced work
Constant thinking loop: full AI review every 3 minutes
Built on **Hermes**: malleable and explainable, edited through files
Use existing subscriptions; never silently pay extra
Best long-term memory system (research said: database + search first, then pilot Hindsight/Honcho)
Every correction becomes a real change (test + skill/code), never a promise
Constantly asks "what went wrong, how do I improve the harness"
Learns his goals over time (harness asks him later)
Personal Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive
School (UIUC) email + Canvas
WHOOP + Oura
iPhone data (Health, Sleep Focus, Screen Time where possible)
iMessages as a data source (read-only; this Mac stays on his Apple ID)
MacBook Pro activity: always-on recorder streaming apps, sites and screen text
Mic: wake word "Toy", plus "record" mode only with consent (Illinois law)
Social media, reading, writing, business tools, and things he didn't ask for
One combined store of all his data that agents can reason over
Keep all data forever; nightly encrypted backups
Business/support emails OK; people he knows need his OK
School work only as far as each course's AI policy allows
Self-improvement can't loosen these rules

v4Design.perComponentRules: Require one mapping for 0.1 plus each LifeStore-intersecting source-group requirement shown per component. Extend existing safe research-file reader to allow only exact sibling REQUIREMENTS.md with current symlink/digest safeguards. Reuse componentDecisions result/findings: bad/missing requirement quote => MAPPED_REQUIREMENTS_MISSING + missingRequirementIds; missing/mismatched version/digest/source quote => PRIMARY_EVIDENCE_MISSING + missingSourceIds; unsupported choice => CHOICE_UNSUPPORTED; missing AT validation => VALIDATION_ID_MISSING. No new inspection DTO or top-level PASS.
v4Design.overlayBinding: Parse V4 records from existing indexed report overlays, bind every record to a canonical in-scope ID including rows with no current reportKeys, and reject duplicates/out-of-scope IDs. Preserve archive original/content digest binding. This is a fixture and record-validation seam, not publisher authentication.
v4Design.provenanceLimit: Fake content can falsify wrong hashes, version locators and quotes. It does not fetch external URLs or prove real source/authorship; researchAttestationVerified stays false.
